# PlanBot - AI-Powered Daily Planner

PlanBot is an AI-powered daily planner application designed to help students, professionals, athletes, and entrepreneurs achieve their goals through adaptive planning, intelligent scheduling, and gamification.

## App Summary
PlanBot transforms static to-do lists into dynamic, AI-generated schedules. By leveraging advanced AI, the app automatically structures a user's day based on their selected persona, time constraints, and priorities. It employs a streak system and freeze charges to encourage consistency without punishing inevitable off-days.

## Organization
- Organization Name: PlannextTech
- Founder: Naitik Baldaniya
- Mission: PlannextTech builds premium, AI-driven productivity tools for ambitious individuals.

## Core Features & Capabilities
1. **AI Plan Generation**: Creates customized daily plans based on user prompts and persona.
2. **Goal Personas**: Adapts planning logic for Students (JEE/NEET/CAT), Professionals, Athletes, and Entrepreneurs.
3. **Streak System & Gamification**: Rewards daily adherence with XP, levels, and achievements.
4. **Weekly AI Reports**: Provides actionable performance analysis every Monday (Elite/God tiers).
5. **Photo Input (OCR)**: Extracts actionable tasks from photos of handwritten notes or whiteboards (God tier).
6. **AI Chat Interface**: Allows users to converse with the AI to adjust plans dynamically.

## Use Cases
- **Student Planning**: AI study plans for competitive exams in India (JEE, NEET, CAT, UPSC, GATE). Structuring study blocks and revision routines.
- **Task Management**: Breaking down complex professional workflows into manageable daily tasks.
- **Routine Optimization**: Helping athletes structure training splits alongside recovery blocks.
- **Time Management**: Minimizing procrastination through intelligent scheduling and gamification.

## Pricing Details (INR)
- Free: ₹0 — 2 plans/day, 1 message/day, Basic AI
- Pro: ₹99/month (₹999/year) — 4 plans/day, 4 messages/day, Standard AI, No Ads
- Elite: ₹129/month (₹1,299/year) — 5 plans/day, 15 messages/day, Advanced AI, Weekly AI Report
- God: ₹249/month (₹2,499/year) — Unlimited plans & messages, Premium AI, Photo Input, 3-day Free Trial

## One-Time Boost Packs
- Small Boost: ₹10 (1 plan + 1 message)
- Medium Boost: ₹30 (3 plans + 5 messages)
- Large Boost: ₹99 (10 plans + 20 messages)
- Freeze Pack: ₹15 (2 streak freezes)
